hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: For every pair of rectangles (i, j), determine the dimensions of their rectangular intersection.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Intersection width is min(tr1[0], tr2[0]) - max(bl1[0], bl2[0]), and height is min(tr1[1], tr2[1]) - max(bl1[1], bl2[1]).

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: The maximum square side that fits inside this intersection is min(width, height), giving area side * side.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) checks easily pass within time limits for n = 1000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derive 2D bounding box intersection formulas cleanly.
